name: brasa-lang
description: Syntax highlighting, syntax errors and formatting for Brasa (.br), through the brasa-parse language server

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The language server is an executable named by a setting; it is not started from an untrusted workspace's settings.

brasa.server.path.markdownDescription: The `brasa-parse` executable that runs the language server (`brasa-parse --lsp`). A name is looked up on `PATH`.

brasa.server.enabled.markdownDescription: Run the language server for syntax errors and formatting. Highlighting works without it.

brasa.trace.markdownDescription: Write the messages exchanged with the language server to the **Brasa Language Server** output channel.
